image_description: A vintage black Olympia typewriter viewed from the front. The image focuses on the keyboard layout, specifically highlighting the long, horizontal space bar at the bottom center. The keys are round and metallic with a worn appearance. The brand name 'OLYMPIA' is visible in gold lettering on the top cover.
